_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 34 recent 12h windows showing ±2+ point score movement, this is a verified coil — no breaker is visible and HOLD with conviction is the skilled, statistically honest call rather than a forced directional guess in a compressed range.
next_move.brains_agree: No split on direction — both brains call HOLD — but they disagree on WHY: analyst sees a stressed coil with no breaker, narrative sees exhaustion before reversal
next_move.confirmed_if: btc_momentum_30d breaks above 60 with funding staying below 0.015% and exchange_netflow dropping below 40
next_move.invalidated_if: vix spikes above 80 with dxy_weakness reversing below 50 and etf_flows collapsing below 60
